name: A. E. Housman
bio: Poet and classical scholar (1859-1936), author of A Shropshire Lad (1896) and elder brother of Laurence Housman. He never met Wilde. Robert Ross learned poems from A Shropshire Lad by heart and recited them to Wilde in Reading Gaol, and Housman sent Wilde a copy of the book himself when he came out. Wilde, writing to his brother, said the two of them had given him 'that rare thing happiness'.
